name: dseX (Python + Next.js)
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; [ -f backend/requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r backend/requirements.txt; [ -d frontend ] && (cd frontend && npm install); echo 'Setup complete'
